responsibility: This header defines the `fujitsu_monaka_tunings` model for the Fujitsu Monaka core in the AArch64 backend. It is currently a variant of the generic Armv9-A tuning bundle with an explicit SVE width and matching vector-throughput tune flags, serving as the named `tune_params` profile that lets the backend distinguish Monaka-specific scalable-vector assumptions from the plain generic Armv9-A model.
